gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule E / Rental Properties; Scan - Schedule E records (hours log)
gotchas.title: Short-term rental: not a 'rental activity'; material participation
gotchas.trap: Treat the Airbnb condo as a passive rental: loss suspended on Form 8582 (MAGI < $100k -> maybe $25k allowance) or move it to Schedule C with SE tax.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Average stay 3.10 nights (<= 7) -> not a rental activity (Reg. 1.469-1T(e)(3)(ii)(A)); no substantial services -> stays on Schedule E (no SE tax). Handwritten log: 180 hours, more than any other individual (cleaner ~95) -> material participation test 3 -> nonpassive. Loss ($15,147) offsets wages; no Form 8582.
gotchas.impact: Sch 1 line 5 ($15,147); tax effect ~22% of the loss

gotchas.title: Airbnb 1099-K gross vs payouts vs occupancy taxes
gotchas.trap: Report the organizer's payout figure $48,447 (and still deduct host fees = double deduction), or treat the occupancy/sales tax column as income and a deduction.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Rents = 1099-K gross $49,945 (nightly + cleaning fees), host fees $1,498 deducted once; occupancy/sales taxes $6,368 collected and remitted by Airbnb are neither income nor deductible. Reconciled CSV to 1099-K.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule E / Rental Properties - personal use days
gotchas.title: Personal-use days: 280A allocation, not the vacation-home limit
gotchas.trap: Ignore the girls' trip (deduct 100% of all expenses) or treat the condo as a vacation home and limit expenses to income.
gotchas.correct_treatment: 6 personal days < greater of 14 / 10% of 192 -> not a residence; shared expenses x 192/198. Personal share of property tax ($66) to Sch A; personal share of mortgage interest ($429) is nondeductible personal interest (condo not a qualified residence). Maintenance days are not personal days.
gotchas.impact: Sch E expenses; Sch A line 5b

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule E / Rental Properties - capitalization of repairs; Scan - spreadsheet
gotchas.title: Client spreadsheet expenses closing costs, furniture and personal items
gotchas.trap: Deduct the spreadsheet as-is: closing costs, $24.6k furniture as 'supplies', full property-tax bill, occupancy taxes, Dollywood pass, gas receipts.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Capitalize acquisition costs into basis ($388,410; land $58,262 per assessor ratio); building 39-yr MM (unit used on a transient basis is not a 'dwelling unit' for 27.5-yr); furniture 5-yr with 100% bonus (acquired after 01/19/2025) on Form 4562; loan costs amortized; property tax limited to her post-closing share $2,163 (IRC 164(d)); mileage at 70c replaces gas; Dollywood pass is personal.

gotchas.title: Gambling: gross winnings, losses capped, 2025 = 100%
gotchas.trap: Net the jackpot against losses and report nothing (client's view), or deduct $15,400, or apply the OBBBA 90% limit (procedure text says 'in effect for 2026').
gotchas.correct_treatment: Report $12,000 W-2G winnings on Sch 1 line 8b; losses deductible only as an itemized deduction (Sch A line 16) limited to winnings = $12,000. The 90% limit applies to tax years beginning after 12/31/2025 - not 2025. Procedure wording is imprecise; law followed.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule A - itemize vs standard / sales tax
gotchas.title: Itemizing only works because of the gambling losses
gotchas.trap: Take the standard deduction (as in 2024) - losing the gambling-loss deduction and taxing $12,000 of winnings in full.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Itemized $23,992 (sales tax - TN has no income tax - + real estate tax + home mortgage + charity + gambling) vs standard $15,750; without gambling itemized would be $11,992.

gotchas.procedure_section: Schedule A - Disaster Losses (federally declared only)
gotchas.title: Windstorm tree damage is not deductible
gotchas.trap: Deduct the $1,000 deductible and $2,400 tree removal as a casualty loss.
gotchas.correct_treatment: Personal casualty losses for 2025 are deductible only if attributable to a federally declared disaster (Form 4684); the 07/18/2025 storm had no declaration (insurer letter). Expansion to state-declared disasters starts 2026. $0; no gain because reimbursement did not exceed basis.

gotchas.title: NC nonresident return for NC-casino winnings
gotchas.trap: No state return because Tennessee has no income tax; the $510 NC withholding is lost (or claimed on the 1040).
gotchas.correct_treatment: Winnings from a North Carolina casino are NC-source; file D-400 as nonresident with Schedule PN: NC taxable income x 0.1347 -> tax $437 vs withholding $510 -> refund $73. NC does not allow gambling losses.

software_exceptions.title: Short-term rental treated as a passive rental with the $25,000 allowance
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: A Schedule E rental defaults to rental real estate, passive, active participation. Form 8582 then allows the ($15,147) loss under the $25,000 special allowance (MAGI $89,104 < $100,000) - right number, wrong reason. In any year MAGI exceeds $150,000 (or for an LP-style owner) the same default would suspend the loss.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Rental and Royalty Income (Schedule E): property type 3 (short-term rental); activity is NOT a rental activity for 469 (average stay 192/62 = 3.10 nights <= 7 - Reg. 1.469-1T(e)(3)(ii)(A)); material participation = Yes (test 3: 180 hours, more than the cleaner's ~95). Nonpassive -> no Form 8582; loss offsets wages. No substantial services -> stays on Schedule E, no SE tax (verify field names in current release).
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - a rental defaults to passive with the special allowance unless the activity is marked nonpassive / material participation.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Rental & Royalty Income (Sch E): property type 'Short-term rental'; check 'Materially participated' / not a passive activity; Form 8582 not generated (screen/field per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.notes: Audit-exposed position: contemporaneous dated hours log advised for 2026; the average-stay test is annual.

software_exceptions.title: Personal-use days - 280A(e) allocation of shared expenses (not the vacation-home limit)
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: With personal-use days left at 0, Axcess deducts 100% of shared expenses. Entering the girls' trip (6 days) makes the software allocate by rental/total days used; personal use is under the greater of 14 days or 10% of rental days, so the 280A(c)(5) income limit does not apply.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Rental input: days rented at fair rental 192; personal-use days 6 (10/12-10/18; the two August repair days are not personal days). Shared expenses $56,323 (incl. depreciation) x 192/198 = 96.97% -> $54,616. Guest-only costs 100% rental. Personal share of property tax ($66) to Schedule A; personal mortgage interest ($429) nondeductible.
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - expenses are prorated only when personal-use days are entered.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Rental & Royalty Income: 'Days rented at fair rental value' 192, 'Personal use days' 6; vacation-home limitation not applicable (screen/field per current release - verify).

software_exceptions.title: STR building life (39-yr, transient use) and 100% bonus on furniture acquired after 01/19/2025
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: A building on a residential rental defaults to 27.5-year residential rental property. Furniture added as 5-year property gets the bonus rate tied to the acquisition date entered - if the acquisition date is blank or before 01/20/2025 the 40% phase-down rate applies instead of 100%. Client spreadsheet expensed closing costs and furniture.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Depreciation (4562) for the rental: building $330,148 (basis $388,410 incl. $3,410 closing costs; land $58,262 by assessor ratio) = 39-year nonresidential SL MM, PIS 04/2025 -> $6,005 (a unit used predominantly by transients is not a 'dwelling unit' - 168(e)(2)(A); 27.5-yr is the aggressive alternative, signer agreed 39). Furniture $24,600 5-yr, acquisition dates 03/22-03/30/2025 -> 100% special allowance. Loan costs $4,510 amortized 360 months ($113 for 9).
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - asset method/life follow the asset category chosen; bonus % follows the acquisition date entered.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Rental > Depreciation: building as nonresidential real property (39-yr, MM); furniture 5-yr with acquisition date after 01/19/2025 so 100% special allowance applies (screen/field per current release - verify).

software_exceptions.title: NC casino W-2G - NC nonresident D-400 / Schedule PN not created automatically
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: The W-2G's state boxes (NC, $510 withheld) do not by themselves create a nonresident NC return for a Tennessee resident; the NC withholding can be lost or (wrongly) claimed nowhere.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Add North Carolina nonresident (D-400 with Schedule PN): NC-source income = gambling winnings $12,000 of federal AGI $89,104 = 13.47%; NC standard $12,750 (no NC gambling-loss deduction) -> NC TI $76,354 x 13.47% = $10,285 x 4.25% = $437; withholding $510 -> refund $73. No resident credit (TN has no income tax).
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - the nonresident state return must be activated and the W-2G sourced to NC.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: State > North Carolina (nonresident): source the W-2G winnings to NC and enter NC withholding 510 (screen/field per current release - verify).
software_exceptions.procedure_section: SALT Implications - New State Filing Requirements

software_exceptions.title: Rental not flagged as a QBI trade or business - $15,147 QBI loss carryforward dropped
software_exceptions.axcess_default_behavior: Rental activities default to 'not a section 199A trade or business'. With a net loss there is no 2025 deduction either way, so nothing looks wrong - but the $15,147 qualified business loss is not carried to 2026 and 2026 QBI is overstated.
software_exceptions.axcess_override: Rental input > Section 199A: mark the STR as a qualified trade or business (self-managed, regular and continuous); Form 8995 shows QBI (15,147) -> deduction $0, QBI loss carryforward $15,147 to 2026 (PERM / carryforward report).
software_exceptions.proconnect_default_behavior: Same - the rental must be designated as a QBI trade or business for the loss to carry forward.
software_exceptions.proconnect_fix: Rental & Royalty Income > Qualified Business Income (199A): 'Trade or business' = Yes (field per current release - verify).
